'''Waterfungi''' was a [[Mushroom/Legends|mushroom]]-like [[Fungus/Legends|fungi]] that was native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuras III]]. They were found in pools of shallow [[Water/Legends|water]] and absorbed nutrients from the ground water. The waterfungi then released clean water as a waste product.
